Don't let anger cloud your mind or destroy your relationships. Breathe deeply, feel this power, and ask yourself: "What can I do with this fire, so that it brings good?" Let your energy become a flame that lights your path, rather than burning bridges. "Anger, in the hands of a master, is a sword of truth. Use it to cut through the bonds of illusion and open the doors to your inner strength."

title: Envy
description: Envy is a mirror reflecting our hidden desires and unrealized possibilities. It is not a punishment, nor a sin, but a sign that within your soul lies an aspiration that has not yet found its path to fulfillment. When you feel envy, ask yourself: what exactly awakens this feeling? Perhaps you envy someone's beauty, success, love, or wealth. But envy is only a reminder from the Lord that these possibilities exist for you too. It points to where you need to direct your energy and actions, in order to create what you desire in your own life. However, it's important to remember: envy must not become a destructive fire. Let it be your compass, not your burden. Look upon what you envy with gratitude. Thank the Universe for showing you examples of what is possible. This is a signal to awaken your own strengths and talents. Turn envy into motivation. Don't compare yourself to others, for your path is unique. Instead, draw inspiration from their successes, and build your own picture of happiness. "Let envy become a light illuminating your path toward great achievement, not a shadow blocking the road to your true destiny."

title: The Core
description: Your inner core is your unshakable foundation, holding you steady in life's hardest moments. It is something deep, unbreakable, your very center, your essence, which fears neither pain, loss, nor fear itself. It is the inner fire that burns even when everything around you seems extinguished. When you find your inner core, you begin to understand that life is not only about victories, but about endurance too. This core is not born from ease; it is forged in trials. It is your compass, showing you where to go, why to go, and what to keep moving forward for. Whoever has found this strength knows that the energy of the Lord lives within them. No outer circumstance can break such a person. They do not surrender to fear, because fear is only illusion. They do not lose themselves in pain, because pain is only a temporary stage. They do not fear loss, because they understand: everything that enters our life either stays, or leaves, making room for something new. This card tells you: trust your inner core. Feel your own strength. Know that you are capable of moving mountains, of passing through any hardship, and that everything you do has meaning. Your core is a gift given to you by God, so you may walk your path to its end, with dignity and strength. Let no obstacle overshadow your faith in yourself. Let fear and doubt dissolve before your inner light. Hold on to your essence, to your own self, and move only forward. Your path is your choice, and your core will lead you to where light, joy, and success await. "Your inner core is a strength that cannot be broken. Hold on to it, and you will pass through any trial leading toward your destiny."

title: Wealth
description: Wealth is the voice of the Lord, a whisper reminding you of your right to abundance. But this is not only about material goods. True wealth begins within, where your connection to the Higher lives, your faith in yourself and your own strength. This card says that wealth doesn't simply arrive on its own. It is the result of the soul's own labor, of harmony with the world, and of an inner recognition of your own worth. Money and resources are only a reflection of your inner state. When you live in an abundance of love, gratitude, and creativity, the material world answers you in kind. The Lord blesses you on the path of abundance, but He also teaches you to be a wise steward of what you're given. Share, give thanks, and direct your resources toward the good of yourself and others. Don't be afraid to ask for more, if you feel ready for it. But remember: wealth without soul is emptiness, and soul without resources is longing. If you feel a lack, ask yourself: where in my life am I not accepting abundance? Perhaps you don't believe in your own worth, or fear there won't be enough money. Release these fears. The Lord will always direct to you what you need, if you trust His path. "Wealth is the light within, reflected into the material world. Accept it, and you will see how life fills with joy and grace."

title: Treasure of Self
description: This card reminds you that your worth is the greatest gift God has granted you. It is not measured in money, possessions, or others' judgments. It is a deep understanding of who you are, what you're capable of, and how your presence enriches this world. The treasure of self is hidden within your soul. It waits for you to find it, uncover it, and acknowledge it. Perhaps you don't yet see it, but every trait of yours, every ability, every effort you make, is a link in the chain leading toward the truth about you. Only you can determine your own true worth, because no one else knows your depths. If you feel lost, or don't understand what it means to have worth, let this card guide you. It says: begin to search. Look within yourself, explore your own nature, your dreams and aspirations. Your inner treasure is not something easily found, but its glow will illuminate your entire path. Like a digger searching for treasure, you must dig deep. This path may be long, difficult, and laborious, but it is worth it. Because once you find your treasure, you will never lose it again. God gave you hands so you could uncover your own unique truth. And when you find this treasure, accept it with gratitude. Let your life fill with the light of recognizing that you are valuable simply because you exist. "The treasure of self is a gift we search for within. Let this path become your source of strength and inspiration."

title: Light of Happiness
description: Happiness is a state every soul strives toward. Everything we do, everything we want, everything we move toward, is only a search for the light of happiness within us. It does not depend on how much money we have, who stands beside us, or whether we have a family or a beloved. Happiness is something more. It is the choice to be in harmony with yourself. For each person, happiness is unique. For one, it's a warm home; for another, the freedom to travel; for a third, stillness, or the joy of contemplation. This card arrives to help you clear away everything excess that blocks your access to happiness. It will point out a path, a small trail, that leads you onto the greater road of joy and peace. It doesn't matter what storms rage around you. What matters is the light you find within yourself. It burns even when everything feels difficult, even when you don't yet realize you are already happy. Accept what is, let go of your expectations, and the light of happiness will illuminate your path on its own. Let this card remind you that happiness lives here and now. It requires no conditions; it doesn't depend on the outer world. Simply be happy. You are the source of your own light. Let your soul find peace, and let happiness become your natural state. "The light of happiness lives within each of us. Let it illuminate your path."

title: Light of Love
description: Love is the foundation of everything that makes life meaningful and full. It is the light that illuminates the soul's path, the healing that brings peace and joy. When the heart fills with love, it heals from pain, fear, and doubt. It grows light, open, and ready to accept the world as it is, with gratitude and harmony. The light of a healed heart brings a state of deep peace. In this state there is no room for suffering, only stillness, joy, and love filling your entire being. Let your heart find this healing, so that peace, happiness, and harmony may settle within it. The Lord grants you love and light that heal the wounds of the past and open new horizons. If you're searching for love, open yourself to this stream. If love already warms your heart, let it grow even deeper, brighter, inspiring you toward great deeds. Every step you take, every breath, is a chance to share this light with the world. Let the light of your healed heart illuminate your path, and the path of those beside you. Let the love you fill yourself with become a gift to the whole world. "Open your heart to love and light. Let them heal you, inspire you, and fill you with joy. Let your heart become a beacon, pointing the way to harmony and happiness."

title: Completion
description: Life is a flow that never stands still. Everything has its beginning and its ending. When something drags on too long, it brings no growth, only draining energy, repeating the same scenarios over and over. This card reminds you: to open the door to something new, you must close the old one. Relationships, places, rituals, projects, everything has its own season. If something in your life no longer serves your good, it's time to say "enough." Completion is not loss, but liberation. It is a chance for a new stage, one that requires space cleared of the old and unneeded. Allow yourself to boldly draw the line. Do it with respect, awareness, and gratitude. Completion is part of creation. When you close one chapter, the Universe writes the next one for you, full of new possibilities and accomplishments. If your heart senses that something has reached its end, trust that feeling. Complete it beautifully, with honor and love, so the space around you fills with light and harmony. "The Gates of Completion open the path to a new beginning. Walk through them with faith, and life will fill with fresh currents of energy and possibility."

title: True Friendship
description: Friendship is a rare gift, shining with true light within the world of relationships. This card invites you to consider who truly stands beside you. There are those who seem like friends, but when trials come, their light dims, leaving behind only the shadow of envy, devaluation, and expectation. They may disguise themselves as support, but their words and actions lead you astray, to a place where you don't belong. True friendship is a union of souls, where there is no envy, no calculation, no need to gain something. It is a bond tested by time, by years of trial and joy, not by fleeting encounters. A real friend will not try to raise themselves at your expense, or secretly envy your success. They will stand beside you, to support you, to inspire you, and to walk with you until the end. Friends you could go to "war" with, knowing they'll never betray you, are rare. These are the ones who share with you not only your joys, but the weight of your trials too. They will not abandon you in hardship, will not turn away when times are hard, and will not seek to gain from you. Let this card help you see the true light of friendship. And let your friendships become a support, a light, and a blessing for you and for those who truly value your presence. "True friendship is a light that never dims, even in the darkest times. Let the fires of your friendship burn bright and warm your soul."

title: Fire of Creation
description: When the fire of inspiration or Creation flares up in your heart, it is the voice of the Lord, calling you to action. This card reminds you: inspiration is divine energy passing through you, so that you may create, build, and fill the world with your unique energy. Don't wait for the flame to fade, don't doubt your own strength, and don't put your ideas off for later. Let this energy pour into your work, your dreams, your desires. Bring it into reality, even if you're unsure of the outcome, for inspiration isn't about pleasing someone else; it is about your path, your soul, your gift. Create for your own sake, for the world's sake, for harmony's sake. Perhaps your work will become a great creation that changes your life or the lives of others. Or perhaps it will simply fill your day with light and joy. But one thing remains constant: every action born from inspiration brings you closer to your true destiny. The fire of inspiration is unique. It gives you the keys to your own code of creation, one no one else can decipher. Try, explore, make mistakes, and discover. Let this energy guide you, becoming a source of joy and strength. "The fire of creation is a gift from the Almighty; light its flame and illuminate the path of your soul."

title: Place of Power
description: This card leads you to where your true strength awakens, where the energies of past and future converge, opening the path to transformation. A place of power is not simply a space. It is a point of passage, where you leave old limitations behind and discover new horizons for yourself. Here, everything heals: your inner child, your feminine or masculine essence, your deepest fears and doubts. The energy of a place of power soaks into your soul, filling it with resolve and inspiration. It directs you toward where you will find happiness, success, and creative fulfillment. Let your heart open to meet this power. It will make you capable of handling hardship and overcoming obstacles. You will remember these moments with a smile, recognizing how far you've come. Let this place of power fill you with light, illuminate your path, and help you reach the peaks you've dreamed of. Let your life become a reflection of the inner strength and harmony you found here. "Strength within and without unites in harmony. Let this place become the point of your rebirth."

title: Mystery of the Lord
description: This card invites you to look beyond the edge of familiar perception. It says: "The Lord, in the conventional sense, may not exist, but there is something greater, the great mystery of creation." This is the energy that drives all processes, that filters our intentions and our efforts, and that opens the way only for those ready for true knowledge. Cards created with this power carry awareness and might within them. But their effect reveals itself only through your own actions. Actions grounded in honesty, resolve, and clarity awaken the power that leads you toward your desired outcome. Let this card remind you: to reach a goal, it's important not only to believe, but to act. Truth reveals itself through the choices you make, through the steps you take. Don't wait for the outcome to arrive on its own. Direct your strength toward where it can reveal your true essence. "The mystery reveals itself to those who act in accordance with the voice of their own soul. This card is about releasing every expectation that someone owes you something, that someone must immediately fulfill your tasks; no one owes you anything. Simply let go, and trust, and everything you need will arrive in its own time."

title: The Lord Knows What He's Doing
description: The Lord never makes mistakes. Even if you feel disappointment, or believe your wish has gone unfulfilled, remember: everything happens according to His design. Every situation in your life is a step along the path toward your true happiness. Grievances against the Lord, the Almighty, or the Universe will bring no answers. Instead, learn to trust and to accept. Trust Him, and say: "Lord, I accept what You give me. Thank You for everything in my life, and for leading me toward what is best." Let this gratitude open your path to joy, health, and harmony. Sometimes you must release your expectations and allow the Lord to give you what you truly need. Say: "Lord, give me what will make my life full and happy. Let it be the person, the work, the possibilities, or the love that truly fits me and my path." Free yourself of illusions and ideas about how things "should be." Simply allow the forces of the Universe to show their care. Let this card remind you: what is given from above is always for your good. Trust Him, and you will find inner peace and true happiness.

title: Prayer for Love
description: Love is not about dreams and illusions, not about a checklist of qualities your partner must possess. It is not about age, figure, status, or faith, the number of children or their absence. All of this creates only a phantom, one that may turn out far from true love. A true prayer for love sounds different; it is born from the depths of your heart and connects you to the Lord's will. "Lord, send me the person who, by Your design, best suits me. Let this person bring happiness and harmony into my life. Let me be ready to love and accept them as they are, and let them be able to love and accept me. I ask You, Lord, for a union built on real love, trust, and acceptance. I ask the Lord to hear my prayers. I forgive everyone who has hurt me before. I release all my expectations, all my thoughts about who I need in my life. I ask only one thing. To find that person. Or rather, not to find them myself, but for You to give me the person who will also want to be with me. Who will show it. And we will both know that we want this. Not through manipulation, nor through any techniques of seduction. Let all of that fall away. Let what reveals itself come from a true source, from real love, from a state of full wholeness within me and my partner, from acceptance." Set aside your expectations, release past grievances and unfulfilled dreams. Allow the Lord to choose for you what will truly bring happiness. Ask for a love that is sincere and real, without manipulation or illusion. Let this person become your guide, your friend, your companion, your partner, your support in any situation: in joy and in sorrow, in success and in hardship, in health and in illness. "Lord, let this be a union filled with love, understanding, and support. Let this person become my reflection, and I theirs. Let them be near, to heal and to inspire, to love and accept me. And I will accept them, with gratitude for the love You sent me. So be it. Simply, let there be someone who can be truly real with you." "Lord, grant me the love I truly deserve. Let there be a person beside me who accepts, values, and sincerely loves me. A person I can trust with my whole heart, who respects my time, my feelings, and returns my love in kind. Grant us a relationship free of scandal, hysteria, intrigue, and separation. Let us live in harmony, joy, and mutual delight in one another. Let our bond be filled with light, trust, and the desire to be together in unity and harmony. With love and gratitude, I accept it into my life. Amen." True love arrives when you are ready for it. Trust the Divine, and your prayer will surely be heard.

title: Prostration
description: There is a practice capable of transforming your life: prostrating before your lineage. It is a profound gesture of gratitude and humility, helping heal grievances, pride, and restore your connection to your roots. The practice is simple: raise your arms upward, then lower yourself onto your stomach, stretching your arms forward. Picture before you your mother, your father, or any member of your lineage with whom you wish to restore harmony. Thank them, ask forgiveness, apologize if needed, compose your own prayer for this process, or take any one that resonates with your soul from the internet. Feel how, through this act, your heart opens. Repeat this ritual several times, for example, 108 times, or fewer if that feels too hard right now. What matters most is to begin. Practice it for several days and observe the changes. You will notice yourself filling with light, and your relationships with your parents and others beginning to shift. Often, the root of our problems lies in grievances, aggression, or a lack of love felt in our relationships with our parents. This practice helps release old blocks and fill your life with harmony. Through prostration, you open the flow of your lineage's energy, letting it fill your life. "Every prostration is a step toward healing the soul and its connection to the lineage. Begin, and life will answer in kind."

title: Kundalini
description: This card reminds you that within each of us lies an inexhaustible source of energy and inspiration. Raising kundalini is a process of awakening life force, one that helps you connect with yourself, your body, your soul, and your spirituality. To activate this energy, you can practice special techniques, or turn to people who can guide you through this. This is not merely exercise, but deep inner work, letting you fill from within with what you've always searched for outside yourself. Awakened kundalini grants clarity, inner strength, and inspiration. It fills you with energy for new beginnings: love, connections, projects, business, and creativity. This is a state from which you can create and live in flow. The key to kundalini is opening your heart, your passion, and your sincere love of life. Let this card become your guide toward reaching the fullness of life. Seek knowledge, practice, and you will see the world around you begin to change along with you. "Awakened kundalini is the path to harmony, inner strength, and inspiration. Fill yourself with it, and create the life you dream of."

title: Rebirth
description: This card reminds you: life begins with your own desire to live. There are moments when everything seems to have stopped, when nothing brings joy, nothing inspires. This state is not an ending, but a pause, a chance to stop and say: "Enough. From this moment, I begin to live the way I want to." Ask the Lord, your lineage, and your own soul to fill you with the energy of life. Let your spirit take you by the hand and lead you forward. Life demands action. Only you can rise in the morning, begin the day with exercise, start dreaming, and move toward your goals. Dare to allow yourself to dream, and to live here and now. No one knows how much time we have, so savor every moment. Life is given to you so you can live it happily, so it may become beautiful and full. "Let life flow through you, filling every moment with happiness, dreams, and the strength to move forward. It's never too late to begin living!"

title: Deep Happiness
description: Happiness has many levels and facets. It can be fleeting, like the joy of seeing a butterfly, or deep, like making love with someone close to you. There is bodily happiness, spiritual happiness, emotional happiness. But the deepest happiness is born when you do something for others, expecting nothing in return. This doesn't have to be for the people close to you that you already interact with. Sometimes it's enough to smile at a stranger passing by, to say a kind word, or to sincerely support another person. Your happiness multiplies when you give it to the world, when from the depths of your heart and soul you share light and joy with your Universe, one in which other people live too, and animals, and this very World called Earth. Let your happiness pass through you, becoming a Source of Light for others. The more you give, the more you fill yourself. Within this flow of happiness, you will find yourself. "Make the world happier. Share your joy, your light, and your warmth, to find deep happiness in every moment."

title: Wrath of God
description: Sometimes life, the Universe, or the Lord sends you an opportunity: love, money, a person, a chance. This may be anything capable of fundamentally changing your life for the better. But when you reject this gift, undervalue its importance, or use it for the wrong purpose, you block your own streams of abundance and encounter the wrath of God. This is not a punishment, but a powerful signal to recognize your own actions and restore balance. For example, you are given money to bring a dream, an important project, or a task to life. But you spend it on something else, not what was originally planned. This creates a hole in your life's space, an energetic blockage that hinders further progress. Such actions lead to a loss of trust between you and the source of abundance. The wrath of God is a reminder of the need to value what enters your life. It is a call to responsibility, awareness, and respect for the gifts sent to you. Learn to receive with gratitude, and to use opportunities for good. "Remember: every action has consequences. Receive gifts with love, watch over your dreams, and do not destroy what comes into your life to fill it."

title: Where the Soul Calls
description: Sit. Calm yourself. Stop. Stop running, and give yourself time to hear your soul. Where is it calling you? The soul is the engine of your life, its true driver. Without it, everything becomes empty and stripped of meaning, like a car without fuel or a driver. Let your soul rise in spirit, awaken, and heal. Feel it filling you with strength, love, and inspiration. The soul leads you to where love, health, harmony, and happiness live. Only it knows your true path, the path to joy and the fullness of life. The soul is a poet, a creator, a source of feeling and meaning. Without it, you are only a body, existing without purpose or delight. Let your soul step out of darkness into the light, where sanctity, divinity, and delight in every minute of life reside. Let your soul guide you. Entrust it with steering the "vehicle" of your existence. Let it show the way to where you will be truly happy. For it is exactly there that love, health, joy, and harmony await you. "The voice of the soul is a light that guides through darkness. Hear it, and you will find yourself."
